known_gaps.description: Exact total/treasury/outstanding share count at 30 Jun and 31 Dec 2021 is not seeded because currently accessible comparatives are rounded to millions. Annual Report 2021 or 1H/2H21 can resolve this.

The exact effective date of the 1,834,272-share greenshoe sale after the Bemobi IPO is not yet confirmed. The post-greenshoe holding of 32,719,588 shares is confirmed, but is conservatively seeded only from 30 Jun 2022.
